summary: Bug: Changing the Estimated Time for a fixed Line total sets all the values for Labor Portion/Parts Portion etc to "0"
reported_issue: For a line configured as a Fixed line total, changing the Estimated Time caused the Labor Portion / Parts Portion (and related values) to be reset to 0 in the line editor. Not reproducible on Production.
expected_after_fix: Changing the Estimated Time on a fixed-line-total line keeps the Labor/Parts portions intact (does not zero them).
steps_i_followed: Identified the fixed-line-total configuration and its portion fields via the API (labour_type_id=fixed_line_total; portions reflected in total_labour_cost / total_parts_sell_price / labor_margin).

Attempted to open the 'Edit Financial Info' / line editor on an editable WO (S9-24917) to change the Estimated Time and watch the portions live — the button_edit_financial_info control was present in the DOM but not reliably actionable, and the New Line / line-editor dialog was intermittent in this harness.
As a supporting check, inspected an existing fixed-line-total line that already has a large Estimated Time set (S9-24715 line 6162a6b2: time_estimate=222).
actual_now: The interactive glitch is a frontend recalculation that only manifests while editing Estimated Time in the line editor, which could not be driven reliably this session. Supporting observation: the existing fixed line S9-24715 has a non-zero Estimated Time (222) together with an intact labor portion (total_labour_cost=300, labor_margin=100, fixed_line_total=300), i.e. no persistent zeroing of portions is visible.
notes: Ticket is OBSOLETE with no fixVersion. The bug is a live frontend calc behavior that requires driving the Edit Financial Info editor, which was not reliably operable in this harness this session. Supporting evidence (a fixed line with a set Estimated Time retaining non-zero portions) leans toward fixed, but the exact live edit could not be performed.
